title: Wedding Cakes
description: A two-tier cake in white and slate, banded low and finished with hand-piped purple daisies and yellow centres climbing over the join. A monogram topper sits above, and the whole thing stands on a gold board with tulle pooled underneath.

alt.purple-and-yellow-floral-cake.jpg: A two-tier white and slate wedding cake with hand-piped purple and yellow daisies and a gold monogram topper
